thread:
ivy: Quick heads-up: opened a docs PR to align the Dedicated provisioning quickstart with the latest API. Need a fast sweep for field names + a short migration callout. Not a full review, just correctness for the code snippets.

 tom_r: Link?

 ivy: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012. Problems I saw: YAML samples still use `reservedPool` and `autoscale.cooldown`; CLI example uses `--provision` flag. Also the SDK snippets call `provision_capacity`.

 kelly: I can take the YAML and SDK bits. We'll normalize to snake_case and new method names. Proposed YAML patch to drop in:

 ```yaml
reserved_pool: "team-a-pool"
autoscale:
  policy: latency
  threshold: 0.7
  cooldown_seconds: 180
  allow_burst: false
labels:
  preemptible: "false"
```

 This replaces camelCase and the deprecated `cooldown` path. I'll also add an inline note under Quickstart: "If you previously automated with the older field names, see Migration notes".

 docs-bot: snippets: regenerated python, ts, and yaml for `dedicated_capacity` at commit 8f7e9. Preview: https://internal/snips/5012 (internal).

 liam: Small thing on SLA text: legal wants us to avoid implying a global pool SLA. Can we add a footnote: "SLA measured per reserved-pool-shard; see SLA matrix" with a link? I'll draft wording.

 paula: On eviction semantics: add a dedicated example showing the cheaper preemptible label. Something like:

 ```yaml
labels:
  preemptible: "true"
  cost_tier: "spot"
```

 and a line about expected behavior: "preemptible=true allows the scheduler to evict for capacity during high demand; use for non-critical batch workloads."

 ivy: Plan: kelly -> YAML + SDK rename + migration callout; liam -> SLA footnote text & link; paula -> preemptible example + short blurb. I'll bundle into a single PR update and ping docs + eng-platform reviewers. Aim: merge by Thursday EOD.

 tom_r: I'll eyeball the prose for clarity after kelly's PR update. Small ask: please keep examples minimal — quickstart readers skim code blocks.

 kelly: Patch branch pushed: `docs/dedicated-quickstart-cleanup`. Updated YAML and SDK snippets, added Migration note draft. Opening PR update now.

 ivy: Thanks all. If we get the snippets link from docs-bot I'll drop it in the PR so CI can pick it up. :thumbsup:

 kelly: Dropped the snippets link in the PR body. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pulls/5012. I'll wait for liam's footnote and paula's preemptible blurb before finalizing.

 liam: Footnote drafted and posted in the PR comments. Wording: "SLA values are reported per reserved-pool-shard. For multi-shard pools, aggregate availability may vary. See SLA matrix for details."

 paula: Preemptible blurb added to PR description with the example snippet.

 ivy: Great — tagging eng-oncall + docs reviewers. Merge target Thursday EOD unless blockers.
